name: Level 1: Living on the Outpost

params.food_rules_subtitle: Safety Briefing: 1) No open liquids — in microgravity, a spilled drink floats and can reach the panels, vents, and the outpost's most sensitive circuits. Choose sealed drinks you can drink through a straw or valve. 2) No crumbly food — crumbs float into the ventilation grilles and circuit boards. Choose food that is sealed, moist, and eaten in one bite — like irradiated chicken in a pouch.

objective: Survive the three outpost challenges: Food, Exercise, and Rest.
briefing: Before you eat, read the safety card. No open liquids: in microgravity, a spilled drink floats and can reach the panels, vents, and the outpost's most sensitive circuits. Choose sealed drinks you can drink through a straw or valve. No crumbly food: crumbs float into the ventilation grilles and circuit boards. Choose food that is sealed, moist, and eaten in one bite — like irradiated chicken in a pouch.

phases.objective: Follow Laika to the mess table.
Read the safety briefing, then select food from the vending machine.

vending.title: FOOD CHALLENGE
vending.subtitle: Select TWO items. Correct: sealed drink + irradiated chicken.

items.name: Sealed Drink
items.desc: Drink with sealed valve, safe for space.
items.note: Presses open; you drink through the valve. No spillage.

items.name: Soda Can
items.desc: Open can; liquid may float in microgravity.
items.note: Open — liquid floats; avoid in space.

items.name: Irradiated Chicken
items.desc: Chicken treated with ionizing radiation, sealed pouch.

phases.objective: Take your meal to the table and eat.
Use the vacuum cleaner to remove all food particles from the panels.
Laika says it's time to exercise. Read the gravity fact.
Go to the vending machine and enter the safety harness code.

vending.title: SAFETY HARNESS
vending.subtitle: Enter the code for the safety harness.

phases.objective: Strap in at the stationary bike or run freely?
Pedal the stationary bike for 22 seconds. Keep the rhythm.
phases.rhythm: alternating left/right adds progress; same key twice reduces gain.

phases.objective: Laika asks where to sleep. Choose a location near a ventilation grille.
Laika sleeps near the ventilation grille. The CO₂ is extracted.
Level 1 complete. Return to the briefing screen.
